app.title: Recording Converter for AnyDesk
save.label: Save to:
bar.realtime: ⓘ One recording converts at a time, in real time — a 40-minute session takes 40 minutes (AnyDesk can only play one recording, at normal speed). Queue as many as you like and use “Start at…” to let them run overnight. The AnyDesk player runs hidden; a new file never starts while you are in a game or a full-screen app.
opt.title: Options
opt.rewind: Start from the first frame (moves the mouse for about half a second per file)
opt.skip_existing: Skip recordings that already have an .mp4
opt.keep_awake: Keep the PC awake while converting
opt.shutdown: Shut down the PC when the queue finishes
